components.name: Editorial Link
components.description: A restrained underlined route for anchors and evidence links.
components.html: Review the current work index
components.css: .ds-editorial-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding-bottom:6px; color:var(--color-accent, #810100); border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; font-family:var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); font-size:12px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; } .ds-editorial-link::after { content:""; width:8px; height:8px; border-top:1px solid currentColor; border-right:1px solid currentColor; transform:rotate(45deg); transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-editorial-link:hover::after { transform:translateX(3px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-editorial-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #810100); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-editorial-link:active { opacity:.72; }

components.name: Program Tab
components.description: A large ruled choice showing index, direction, and short rationale.
components.css: .ds-program-tab { display:grid; grid-template-columns:38px 1fr; align-content:center; gap:7px 16px; width:100%; min-height:150px; padding:24px clamp(20px, 3vw, 42px); color:var(--color-ink, #241f1f); background:var(--color-cotton, #edebdd); border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-hairline, #d6d2c2); text-align:left; transition:color 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-program-tab > span { grid-row:1 / span 2; font:500 12px/1 var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-program-tab strong { font:400 clamp(1.7rem,3vw,3rem)/.9 var(--font-family-display, Arial Black, sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-program-tab small { grid-column:2; font:400 .98rem/1.3 var(--font-family-serif, Georgia, serif); } .ds-program-tab:hover, .ds-program-tab:focus-visible, .ds-program-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color:var(--color-cotton, #edebdd); background:var(--red-cherry, #810100); } .ds-program-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--red-chili-300, #e5595c); outline-offset:-4px; } .ds-program-tab:active { background:var(--red-maroon, #630000); }

components.name: Active Program Tab
components.description: The selected state for a bounded direction.
components.css: .ds-program-tab-active { display:grid; grid-template-columns:38px 1fr; align-content:center; gap:7px 16px; width:100%; min-height:150px; padding:24px clamp(20px, 3vw, 42px); color:var(--color-cotton, #edebdd); background:var(--red-cherry, #810100); border:0; text-align:left; transition:background 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-program-tab-active > span { grid-row:1 / span 2; font:500 12px/1 var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-program-tab-active strong { font:400 clamp(1.7rem,3vw,3rem)/.9 var(--font-family-display, Arial Black, sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-program-tab-active small { grid-column:2; font:400 .98rem/1.3 var(--font-family-serif, Georgia, serif); } .ds-program-tab-active:hover, .ds-program-tab-active:active { background:var(--red-maroon, #630000); } .ds-program-tab-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--red-chili-300, #e5595c); outline-offset:-4px; }

components.name: Handoff Control
components.description: A full-width stateful action that accepts or returns responsibility.
components.css: .ds-handoff-control { display:flex; width:100%; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:22px 26px; color:var(--color-cotton, #edebdd); background:var(--color-noir, #1b1717); border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(237,235,221,.18); font:500 12px/1 var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-handoff-control::after { content:""; width:9px; height:9px; border-top:1px solid currentColor; border-right:1px solid currentColor; transform:rotate(45deg); } .ds-handoff-control:hover, .ds-handoff-control:active { background:var(--red-maroon, #630000); } .ds-handoff-control[aria-pressed="true"]::after { transform:rotate(-135deg); } .ds-handoff-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--red-chili-300, #e5595c); outline-offset:-4px; }

components.css: .ds-evidence-card { display:grid; color:var(--color-ink, #241f1f); text-decoration:none; } .ds-evidence-media { position:relative; display:block; aspect-ratio:4 / 3; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(145deg, #291516, #0b0909); transition:filter 650ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 650ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-evidence-media > span { position:absolute; left:18px; bottom:16px; color:var(--color-cotton, #edebdd); font:500 10px/1 var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-evidence-copy { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(180px,.7fr); gap:22px; padding-top:22px; border-top:1px solid var(--color-hairline, #d6d2c2); } .ds-evidence-copy small { color:var(--color-gray, #6e6963); font:500 10px/1 var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-evidence-copy strong { display:block; margin-top:8px; font:400 clamp(2rem,4vw,4rem)/.9 var(--font-family-display, Arial Black, sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-evidence-copy p { margin:0; color:var(--color-gray, #6e6963); font:400 .84rem/1.45 var(--font-family-ui, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-evidence-card:hover .ds-evidence-media { filter:saturate(1); transform:scale(1.012); } .ds-evidence-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #810100); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-evidence-card:active { opacity:.78; }

narrative.overview:
Convenium is a warm editorial studio, not a technology showroom. Warm ivory paper, near-black rooms, cherry interventions, tactile campaign media, and thin registration geometry give unfinished ideas a place to be examined with care. Compressed Archivo Black makes the decisive claims; Newsreader slows the explanatory voice; Inter keeps controls and metadata exact.

The system expresses one durable thesis: unfinished ideas deserve careful diagnosis, bounded direction, accountable coordination, and a coherent result. `/about-v3` makes that thesis visible through ten chapters: thesis, founders, arrival, diagnosis, three futures, system intake, orchestration, recovery, proof, and inquiry. Its first viewport is a dark editorial stage with an oversized thesis, an honest founder-film production hold, compact supporting copy, and a single anchor into the story.

This record describes the shipped, code-led Olympus direction. No concept-roll seed key applies. The build's world and tokens are authoritative; production gaps and unverified evidence stay visibly disclosed rather than being disguised as polish.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cotton and noir chapter fields interrupted by disciplined cherry, never a rainbow palette.
Monumental compressed display type paired with reflective serif prose and compact neutral UI text.
Thin rules, registration marks, asymmetric editorial grids, and large protected media fields.
Tactile generated or supplied media with explicit provenance and honest production-status language.
Restrained, forward motion that clarifies state, handoff, selection, or reveal.
Founder accountability and public process boundaries embedded in the interface.

rules.name: The Three-Red Rule
rules.body: Cherry selects, maroon deepens, and chili signals; the roles are not interchangeable.

rules.name: The Cotton-on-Red Rule
rules.body: Cotton is the text color on every cherry or maroon field; never place noir text on those reds.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep interface accents inside the red family. Cyan may appear only when it is intrinsic to the supplied Apollo imagery, never as a competing UI accent.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black decides, Newsreader explains, and Inter operates; do not swap their responsibilities for novelty.

rules.name: The Short-Display Rule
rules.body: Oversized uppercase display copy stays concise enough to remain a composed shape, not a dense paragraph.

rules.name: The Bounded-Process Rule
rules.body: Make the public route, roles, states, and review points legible; do not expose private prompts or hidden internal routing.

rules.name: The Protected-Media Rule
rules.body: Place critical copy in deliberate negative space or under a controlled overlay, never across an uncontrolled focal subject.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate layers with field color, hairlines, crop, and light before considering shadow.

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Thin geometric marks may clarify alignment, capture, state, or sequence; every mark needs a structural reading.

dos: Do alternate cotton and noir chapter fields to pace long stories and make transitions legible.
Do use cherry for decisions and selected states, maroon for depth, and Soft Chili for small red text on noir.
Do keep tactile media provenance, proposal status, production holds, and public process boundaries visible in the interface.
Do preserve keyboard semantics, readable mobile order, WCAG AA text contrast, poster fallbacks, and coherent reduced-motion behavior.
Do let generated or supplied media carry material texture while interface typography remains real, selectable text.
donts: Don't fabricate testimonials, outcomes, client evidence, founder material, or hidden process detail to make a section feel complete.
Don't introduce gold, orange, generic cyan UI, glass blobs, glossy science-fiction surfaces, or decorative 3D icons into this warm editorial world.
Don't repeat kicker or eyebrow labels as a default pre-heading device; use compact metadata only when it communicates orientation, status, provenance, or action.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as interface icons; draw simple geometry in CSS or use an intentional inline SVG when an icon is necessary.
Don't add procedural SVG grain. Texture belongs to authored raster media and controlled photographic treatment, not a universal noise layer.
Don't use Chili for body-size text on noir or place noir text on cherry or maroon.
